title: Exactness of the constructed free module complex on chosen Cech products
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category with hom-sets in universe $v$, $R:\mathcal C^{op}\to\mathrm{Ring}$ a presheaf of rings valued in $v$, $T$ a set in $v$, and $f_t:U_t\to U$ a family. Let $S$ specify the chosen products and index maps [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. Form $P_n(X)=\coprod_{t\in T^{n+1}}\operatorname{Hom}(X,S.W(n,t))$, with restriction by precomposition and index maps $(t,a)\mapsto(t\circ\alpha,a\circ S.indexMap(t,\alpha))$. Let $K=S.freeComplex(R)$ be the alternating chain complex of objectwise free $R$-module presheaves [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] on this simplicial presheaf. Then $K$ is exact at $n+1$ for every $n\ge0$. No covering or injectivity hypothesis is used.

proof.text: Evaluate at X. Partition the basis (t,a) by the composite φ:X→U. The product universal property identifies its fibre with (n+1)-tuples in the disjoint union Lφ of lifts X→f(i) with composite φ. The inverse is the unique product lift. indexMap_pr verifies compatibility with coordinate deletion.

Extend the basis identification linearly. The evaluated complex is the direct sum over φ of the tuple complexes on Lφ with ring R(X). The empty case is zero. In the nonempty case, insert a chosen lift; [lem-weil-pbc-power-set-complex-contractible] gives exactness at n+1, including n=0. Direct sums preserve exactness for modules.

Module-presheaf kernels and cokernels are objectwise, so evaluation jointly reflects exactness. Thus the objectwise result proves K.ExactAt(n+1). Shared universe v ensures the constructed modules belong to PresheafOfModules.{v} R.
